_spec: hopeOS face-puppet contract v1. One file = one puppet. Positions never cross the human->puppet boundary; each channel names a MEASURE evaluated by the same formula on both sides (sdk/interaction/face-measures.js), a per-user human calibration, a puppet response curve, and the rig target it drives. A channel is LIVE only when every field is non-null and 'status' is 'calibrated' -- the riglab ghost view shows exactly which channels pass.

human.smoothing: One-Euro applied on the HUMAN side only (minCutoff 2.0, beta 0.15); puppet applies raw
calibration_ritual: neutral: 2s hold, face relaxed, eyes open, mouth closed -> per-channel 'neutral'
range:   open mouth wide, blink hard, tongue out far   -> per-channel 'max'

puppet.index_warning: vertex indices below bind to THIS geom_sha1. The Blender working copy had a cavity boolean applied (120624 verts) -- marks made there DO NOT transfer to this GLB. Mark on the pristine mesh or re-export and re-digest.

puppet.marking: 4 verts on the lizard mouth: inner-lip mids at the slit front (upper/lower), and the two mouth corners where the carved slit ends
puppet.response_curve_method: Blender sweep: pose mouth_open 0->1 in 21 steps, evaluate deformed mesh (depsgraph), record puppet MAR at each step, store LUT + inverse

human.note: MediaPipe has no tongue landmark; red-ratio inside the inner-lip polygon is the probe (mouth.js). Already smoothed + hysteresis.

puppet.marking: 2 verts: tongue root (base on mouth floor) and resting tip
puppet.response_curve_method: sweep tongue_out 0->1, record tip displacement / rest length

human.note: 2D tip centroid in mirrored normalized coords; x-offset from mouth center -> yaw, y -> pitch

puppet.note: tongue chain has no yaw/pitch drivers yet -- rig extension needed (tongue_01 rotation)

human.note: degrees, mirrored-view convention, One-Euro smoothed; requires faceMatrix:true

puppet.note: NO head bone exists -- jaw parents to root. Add 'head' bone (neck pivot ~(-0.17,-0.45,0.30)), reparent jaw+tongue chain under it
gecko has no eyelids; stylized model could take a lid shape key -- design call, not anatomy
lizard slit is rigid; would need corner shape keys
